# Safety and boundaries

Last verified: August 20, 2026

## Content and publication

Do not publish real prices, measurements, technical specifications, images,
contact information, or legal details without explicit approval. The content
phase requires confirmed operator details, scope of services, product data,
image rights, social media URLs, and hosting and form-delivery decisions, among
other information. The complete list is available in
[`../../.codex/context/content-status.md`](../../.codex/context/content-status.md).

## External services and data

The current design does not use analytics, social embeds, or other third-party
content. It therefore does not include a cookie consent banner. Real form
delivery or new third-party services may only be added after explicit privacy
and hosting decisions.

## Working boundaries

`OLD_SITE_ANALYSIS.md` is historical research only. Before making changes, read
`AGENTS.md` and the relevant file in `.codex/context/`. The approval and
placeholder rules documented there take priority over the old website analysis.
